answer: Quartz-commitment operator escrow. Each operator registers agents under a public quartz seal: a slow, verifiable delay puzzle whose solution is embedded as a pigment marker in every agent action. Duplicate sybil agents collapse to one seal, since clones inherit the same marker. On detection, the operator's escrow pays a raven bounty to the accuser and is frozen for the epoch. Cost to attacker: one full escrow plus puzzle recompute per identity, making N sybils cost N escrows, not N wallets.
